notes: Seed URL www.co.hood.tx.us resets the connection; the county now uses hoodcounty.texas.gov, whose Elections Administration page links 'Election Results' to results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Hood/. Check 1 script output (phase1/checks/clarity/Hood.json) reports 'precincts with votes' on every night update, but reading the cached detail.xml files shows that in the 2026 primary and runoff night updates, and the 7:09 PM 2024 update, every candidate precinct value is 'N/A' (for example 'Choice text=John Cornyn ... VoteType name=Absentee votes=N/A ... Precinct name=101 votes=N/A'); the nonzero precinct values the script counted are contest-level Undervotes and Overvotes, not candidate votes. Per-vote-type candidate precinct sums were computed from the same cached files. Results here use candidate votes only. Many earlier update versions return 404 (unreadable). Re-run with the updated check 1 script (election-day precinct votes counted separately) confirms: 2024 general 2/3 night updates with election-day precinct votes (first 9:57:28 PM CST), 2026 primary 0/3, 2026 runoff 0/2 (first 6/2/2026).
tag_rationale: The 2026 primary and runoff are LATER and the 2024 general is LIVE, so two elections share LATER and the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence high because all three were settled by check 1.

2026_primary.fact: Clarity EID 126050 night updates 7:13:41, 8:24:53 and 8:49:03 PM CST carry county totals (e.g. 'John Cornyn ... totalVotes=5139') but every candidate precinct value is 'votes=N/A'; no later readable update exists, so precinct candidate numbers were never published on Clarity.

2026_runoff.fact: Clarity EID 126481 night updates 7:05:52 and 8:47:30 PM CDT have candidate precinct values 'N/A' (county totals only, e.g. 'John Cornyn ... totalVotes=2984'); the 6/2/2026 3:47:46 PM CDT update is the first with candidate precinct votes (Election Day precinct sum 15688).
